1913
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 12
Page 21 Cont.
Oct. 1st left St. Paul on N.P.R. Road and with Rev. E. F. Casey, from St. Paul and Mr. J. M. Casey from Sup- erior, Wis reaches Plains, Mont. Oct. 3rd 1st Friday, where three Casey brothers say holy Mass. - Plains is a beautiful mountain town.
Oct. Feast of St. Francis arrives in Seattle at 7.50 A.M. Says Mass at 8.30. Afterwards meets friends of 20 years ago
Oct. 6th Parents Golden Jubilee Solemn high Mass at 9:30 Celebrant Rev. M.C. Casey of Plains D. Fr. Solanus of Yonkers, N.Y. S.D. Rev. E. F. Casey of St. Paul, Minn. After Mass, beautiful and poetic program. In evening Songs old and new with original poems and music for the occasion.
Oct. 7. Mass in Carmelite Convent at 7.A.M. - 7:10 P.M. bade Good Bye to Parents and friends hoping to meet in Heaven if never again of Earth.
Oct. 10 Holy Mass in St. Paul - first since leaving Seattle.
Page 22
Oct. 11 Holy Mass in Detroit - first time in Alma-Noviate in Detroit - first time in Alma - Noviate in nine years.
Oct. 11 Arrived in Yonkers after seventeen day absence.
Oct. 12th Laying of Corner-Stone from Ireland of New Church - cleared over $1900.00 on same
